signature_moves: Editorial high-contrast serif carries the entire brand voice (not a product sans) — the whole personality in one type decision
Warm iridescent aura (coral/peach/amber + one cool lilac note) bleeding around a crisp white content-circle — atmosphere outside, discipline inside
Tactile flocked-clay 'Thinker' mascot icon that rejects platform icon grammar (no squircle field, no SF-Symbol abstraction, no Liquid-Glass layers) — brand-over-platform

aesthetic.direction: Editorial/literary (contrast serif) remixed with Organic/soft surface (iridescent aura mesh + soft-3D tactile mascot) — a warm-editorial productivity brand

psychology: Von Restorff / single-focal — one serif headline is the sole focal element; everything else recedes (the first-viewport thesis statement)
Aesthetic-usability & processing fluency — centered serif + soft warm gradient reads calm and fluent in the ~50ms first-impression window (read from the marketing composite, not the app)
Tesler's Law (framing, copy-level) — 'Organize nothing' promises the app absorbs the organizing complexity; noted as marketing framing, not design evidence
